label: Машина
description: Twelve-mission case drill for машина (car, machine) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form машина serves as the subject of стоит. First-declension feminine nouns in -а keep this bare ending in the nominative singular, naming who or what performs the action.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The ending changes from nominative -а to машины, here governed by the absence construction нет plus genitive. Hard feminines take the genitive singular ending -ы.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. After the preposition к expressing motion toward, машина becomes машине. The dative singular ending for first-declension feminines is -е.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of моет takes the accusative машину, where nominative -а becomes -у. Being inanimate, машина uses this dedicated -у form for the accusative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The verb гордиться governs the instrumental, so машина appears as машиной. The instrumental singular ending for hard feminines is -ой.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. After в marking location inside, машина takes the prepositional машине. The prepositional singular ending -е matches the dative for first-declension feminines.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is машины, where singular -а changes to the plural ending -ы. This -ы marks the nominative plural of hard feminine nouns.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. Hard feminines drop the vowel entirely in the genitive plural, leaving the zero-ending form машин. The negation нет plus genitive triggers it here.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The dative plural ending -ам attaches to the stem to give машинам, the recipient of the parts. The -ам ending is uniform for hard feminine plurals.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. Because машина is inanimate, the accusative plural copies the nominative plural машины rather than the genitive. The direct object of выпускает stays машины.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The instrumental plural ending -ами produces машинами, here the means clogging the road. This -ами ending is regular across hard feminine nouns.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. After в indicating location, the prepositional plural ending -ах gives машинах. This ending is constant for hard feminines in the prepositional plural.
